c: Search Employee Center for what you need, or browse the topics.
say: Search Employee Center for what you need, or browse the topics on the home page.

c: Its page shows the price, the Delivery Time and its questions.
say: The item's page shows its price, the delivery time, and its questions. Answer them, and set the quantity if you need more than one.

c: Press Order Now (or Submit, Request). Each order is one item.
say: Press order now. Some items say submit or request. There is no cart: each order is one item.

c: Confirm, adding delivery details or special instructions if useful.
say: Confirm the order, and add delivery details or special instructions if useful.

c: You land on your request: its REQ number, the expected delivery and its stage.
say: You land on your request's status, with its number, the expected delivery, and its stage.

c: Save as Draft keeps it to finish later.
say: Not ready? Save as draft keeps it under My Requests, to finish later.
